messages:
alex: Hey team — after upgrading our app to the latest py-sdk we started seeing silent auth failures and duplicate charge events for some users. Not sure if it's on our side or a client change. Logs + minimal repro below. pls help :

maria: sorry ! can you paste the pip freeze and the snippet you run in prod? also which env var you set for the key?

alex: pip: `redwood-sdk==1.13.0` plus a bunch of other deps. we set `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in k8s. repro:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# simple request
client.completions.create(model="gpt-3-small", prompt="hi")
```
Logs:
```
2026-02-18T10:12:05.123Z ERROR request 401 Unauthorized for /v1/completions
2026-02-18T10:12:05.124Z INFO retrying request (attempt=1)
2026-02-18T10:12:05.324Z ERROR request 401 Unauthorized for /v1/completions
2026-02-18T10:12:05.325Z INFO retrying request (attempt=2)
2026-02-18T10:12:05.525Z INFO request succeeded 200 /v1/completions
```
The weird bit is the first two 401s, then a success — results in multiple billable requests.

samir: thanks for the repro, alex. quick check: in 1.13 we removed the alias `api_key` and the constructor now expects `credentials` (and will read `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env only for the new flow). we attempted to make the old arg a silent no-op but apparently that made the header not sent in some bootstrap cases. tl;dr: `api_key` is ignored in 1.13, so your client started sending unauthenticated requests and retry logic generated duplicates.

maria: ah that makes sense. alex, can you confirm you didn't also set `REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS`? if not, workaround is to pass the new param or pin to previous release.

alex: i can try passing `credentials=...` directly but we rely on k8s env injection and a large image rollout — quicker for us to pin. what pin should we use?

samir: pin to `redwood-sdk==1.12.4` for now. we'll push a hotfix that reintroduces a compatibility shim that emits a DeprecationWarning instead of dropping the arg. i'll open an issue and a patch release (1.13.1) this morning.

julia: also note the default retry/backoff is aggressive in older SDK versions — if you have network flakiness that will multiply billable requests. for immediate mitigation you can set a lower retry count: `client.config.retries = 1` or set `REDWOOD_RETRY_COUNT=1` in your environment. that should reduce duplicates until you upgrade.

alex: pinned to 1.12.4 in staging, reran the failing flow — no duplicate charges, logs show single 200. thanks.

samir: opened GH issue #4521 and will link the patch PR shortly. short term plan: 1) release 1.13.1 with compatibility shim, 2) publish migration note documenting `api_key -> credentials` and env var names, 3) add test to prevent silent arg drops.

maria: thanks both. alex — if you want we can escalate to priority support to audit any customer charge windows. ping me if you want that. :thumbsup:

alex: appreciated, will reach out if we see more.

deploy-bot: release redwood-sdk@1.13.1 scheduled for 2026-02-18T15:00:00Z (patch to restore backward-compat).
